title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse
description: Mickey and his friends Minnie, Donald, Pluto, Daisy, Goofy, Pete, Clarabelle and more go on fun and educational adventures.

episodes.title: S4-E1Mickey and Donald Have a Farm

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x1
episodes_data.description: We meet the gang again in a brand new educational television show for kids!

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x2
episodes_data.description: The gang prepares a special secret surprise for Minnie Mouse which makes her day.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x3
episodes_data.description: There is much excitement when Goofy gets a cute pet bird.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x4
episodes_data.description: The gang is bored so Donald comes up with a creative idea with a big balloon race!

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x5
episodes_data.description: Donald runs in to a beanstalk and some weird thing take place.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x6
episodes_data.description: Goofy leaves his pet kitten, Mr. Pettibone, with Mickey, but Mr. Pettibone only eats big red gooey fish.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x7
episodes_data.description: Donald turns into a frog prince.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x8
episodes_data.description: The group of friends celebrate Minnie's birthday and there are more surprises coming her way.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x9
episodes_data.description: Goofy travels all the way to Mars.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x10
episodes_data.description: Mickey plays hide and seek with his friends but when Mickey hides really well, everyone gets worried about him

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x11
episodes_data.description: While attending a dance, Daisy gets stage fright when it is time for her to perform.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x12
episodes_data.description: Pluto is outside playing with his favorite ball, when he bounces it a little too high and it rolls away. Mickey and Pluto set out to save the day and find the lost ball.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x13
episodes_data.description: Mickey believes that there is treasure somewhere and convinces all of his friends to search for it.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x14
episodes_data.description: Daisy, Pluto and Minnie are carried away by a bunch of balloons.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x15
episodes_data.description: Pluto starts baby-sitting Clarabelle Cow's puppies and soon realizes that they aren't as easy to watch as he thought they would be.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x16
episodes_data.description: Pluto and Butch, Pete's dog, compete for a trophy by playing a variety of games.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x17
episodes_data.description: It's Halloween for Mickey and the gang and they get an invitation to go to Pete's Halloween Party located at the Trick-or-Treat Tower.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x18
episodes_data.description: Minnie Mouse goes out into the woods and ventures across some trouble. Will her friends save the day?

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x19
episodes_data.description: Minnie picks a magic rose that puts a curse on her that makes her sleep for 100 years if the spell is not broken.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x20
episodes_data.description: Mickey and Donald run to save Santa Claus so that he can deliver the presents to everyone, otherwise there will be no Christmas.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 1x21
episodes_data.description: Goofy is performing in a magic show, but things start to go wrong right before the show is set to begin.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x1
episodes_data.description: When Clarabelle invites Goofy to go with her to the Fancy Dance, the gang helps him learn gentlemanly ways.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x2
episodes_data.description: When the handy Helpers break down, Mickey and the gang work to fix them.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x3
episodes_data.description: Goofy and the gang construct a birdhouse for Baby Red Bird and his family

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x4
episodes_data.description: When Professor Ludwig Von Drake's Time Machine turns Goofy into a baby, Mickey and the gang must babysit Goofy Baby until the machine is fixed.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x5
episodes_data.description: Goofy tries to run an obstacle course and gets help from his friends. Goofy is practicing for the Mickey Mouse Obstacle Course in hopes of winning a medal.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x6
episodes_data.description: Minnie decides to memorialize the new picnic area of the clubhouse by organizing the first picnic with the help of her friends.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x7
episodes_data.description: Mickey and friends practice their band's music for the Mickey Park Polka-Palooza Dance Festival where the elephants will dance the Pachyderm Polka.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x8
episodes_data.description: Minnie attempts to find out who took her fresh baked muffins from the clubhouse.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x9
episodes_data.description: Today is the Clubhouse's "Picture Day," where all of the Mickey Mouse Clubhouse friends get their picture taken. But it seems that Goofy is too disappointed to take his picture because he lost his hat.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x10
episodes_data.description: The Clubhouse mail has arrived for all of the Clubhouse friends except Donald. It's up to the Clubhouse friends all make Donald feel better.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x11
episodes_data.description: Daisy has trouble finding a pet for the Pet Parade. She must find a pet before the Pet Parade starts. She gets three pets, an elephant named Bubbles, a giraffe named Longfellow and a bunny named Captain Jumps-a-Lot.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x12
episodes_data.description: With Mickey and friends' help, Clarabelle sets up a carnival at the Clubhouse grounds. The reason for it is her need to feed the chickens with lots of corn.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x13
episodes_data.description: Minnie wants to have a picture of a hula hibiscus to complete her flower picture collection, but she has only one day to get it, when it is in full bloom. She will need help from all of her Clubhouse friends to get to where the flower is located.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x14
episodes_data.description: Ludwig Von Drake's package of wild numbers has arrived at the Clubhouse. However, they are accidentally let out and it is up to Mickey and his Clubhouse friends to don cowboy/cowgirl clothes and gear and round them all up to the "MickeyCorral" on the grounds before the Professor returns from an errand. Note: This is the only time something is alive.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x15
episodes_data.description: Mickey and the gang take care of Willie the Giant's farm while he's away.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x16
episodes_data.description: Everyone wants to view Mickey's Comet, but first they have to find Professor Von Drake and his telescope. This was the second episode in the series, following 'Doctor Daisy, M.D.', that the 'Mystery Mousketool' was chosen first.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x17
episodes_data.description: Mickey and the rest of the Clubhouse friends have a "Big Clubhouse Camp Out. They are trying to earn a Clubhouse Camp Out badge for each one of them by doing two tasks at a campsite.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x18
episodes_data.description: Goofy learns to sculpt, paint and draw so he can compete in an arts-and-crafts show sponsored by Mickey.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x19
episodes_data.description: Mickey and the gang build a train, so they can carry the professor's non-melting snow to the Clubhouse.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x20
episodes_data.description: A story Mickey plans to read aloud about an enchanted egg, suddenly becomes real. The big purple dragon egg Wizard Pete is taking care of, rolls out of the castle and into Donald and Goofy while they are walking to the Clubhouse. A purple baby dragon pops out of the egg. Mickey and friends name it Zoe and take it to Wizard Pete, while trying to get out of his traps.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x21
episodes_data.description: Clarabelle and Bella are coming over for tea and biscuits and dog biscuits and Pluto is all dirty and needs a bubble bath. But when Pluto's bubble bath gets out of hand, Mickey and Pluto each get stuck inside a giant bubble and float away from the clubhouse.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x22
episodes_data.description: Goofy gets cloned after Professor von Drake's new experimental Gooey-Goo splashes onto him. Mickey and his friends must take care of the clones until the effect wears off.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x23
episodes_data.description: Donald leads the gang on a mission to the moon to retrieve Pluto's bouncy ball.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x24
episodes_data.description: Daisy protects Clarabelle's secret recipe for oatmeal raisin cookies from Pete.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x25
episodes_data.description: The clubhouse's "silly switch" gets stuck and makes everyone act in comical ways, such as Mickey only speaking in rhyme and Pluto making every animal sound except barking.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x26
episodes_data.description: Minnie searches for a pot of gold and meets a leprechaun after a rainbow appears over the clubhouse.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x27
episodes_data.description: Mickey and his friends throw a beach party to cool off on the hottest day of the year and Pete invites everyone.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x28
episodes_data.description: Mickey and his friends help Salty the Seal do tricks for the circus.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x29
episodes_data.description: Goofy wants to be knighted by Queen Clarabelle, so he proves his bravery by going on a quest to retrieve three items.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x30
episodes_data.description: Minnie uses a growth spray in her garden to help her fruits and vegetables grow in time to be picked for Thanks A Bunch Day, but it turns them all into gigantic creations.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x31
episodes_data.description: Help Detective Minnie and Secret Spy Daisy search for missing party hats for the clubhouse's Friendship Day celebration.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x32
episodes_data.description: When Goofy's friend Coco the Monkey can't find any coconuts for her "coconutty party," Goofy, Mickey and the clubhouse gang take a trip into the jungle in search of coconuts.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x33
episodes_data.description: Pluto comes to the rescue when Donald and Goofy build a snowman so big, they can't climb around it or over it.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x34
episodes_data.description: Clarabelle stages a musical about nursery rhymes starring chickens from the petting zoo, but they practice so much, they lose their voices.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x35
episodes_data.description: Mickey, Daisy, Goofy and Pluto fly up to Mars and help a Martian Mickey find a secret treasure.nnGuests - Ludwig Von Drake, Pete, Martian Mickey and Pluto from Pluto.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x36
episodes_data.description: Donald helps a group of ducks get to a warm beach for their winter retreat.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x37
episodes_data.description: A mechanical cuckoo bird that's a birthday gift for Daisy flies away, and the gang embarks on an imaginative Alice in Wonderland-like adventure to retrieve it.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x38
episodes_data.description: Goofy trains to be a superhero and uses his skills after Clarabelle's moo-muffin maker breaks.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 2x39
episodes_data.description: Help Mickey and his friends solve the five Fun Puzzles to get a Big Surprise.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x1
episodes_data.description: Goofy constructs a robot in his own likeness.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x2
episodes_data.description: Mickey and Minnie kick off the first day of spring with an egg hunt.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x3
episodes_data.description: Goofy becomes Super Goof to solve some puzzles laid out by Pete.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x4
episodes_data.description: The Clubhouse's sandbox is empty, so Donald leads the gang into the desert to get more sand. But they stumble across much more than that.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x5
episodes_data.description: It is Toodles' birthday and the whole gang is there to celebrate.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x6
episodes_data.description: When Goofy The Great makes Pluto's dog house disappear, it's up to Mickey and the gang to find it.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x7
episodes_data.description: The Professor accidentally brings back a baby dinosaur while using his time machine.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x8
episodes_data.description: Minnie throws a pajama party for all her friends.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x9
episodes_data.description: Mickey and his pals participate in a road rally that takes them across sandy deserts, over snow-covered mountains and through lush jungles.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x10
episodes_data.description: Pete The Genie gives Donald genie powers so that he can make his friend's wishes come true.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x11
episodes_data.description: Mickey and the gang have to find Daisy's pet grasshopper Wilbur so that the Professor can take his picture for Grasshopper Day.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x12
episodes_data.description: Mickey and the gang help Pete get in shape by Mousekersizing.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x13
episodes_data.description: Mickey and his pals search for three wind-up toy musicians after they run about due to being wound too tight just before a parade appearance.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x14
episodes_data.description: When the pages of Minnie's calendar blow away, it's up to the gang to help her get them back.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x15
episodes_data.description: Minnie loses her cat, Figaro, who makes a big mess after she makes a surprise for him. Pluto and Mickey pitch in to help track down Minnie's cat.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x16
episodes_data.description: Minnie opens a boutique filled with a variety of bows and bow ties.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x17
episodes_data.description: Minnie decides to have a masquerade ball.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x18
episodes_data.description: Goofy goes on a quest for a magical elixir to cure Willie The Giant's tummy ache.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x19
episodes_data.description: Mickey leaves Donald in charge of the clubhouse and it quickly turns into a disaster area when he and Goofy make a huge mess just before Mother Goose Clarabelle is to visit.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x20
episodes_data.description: Martian Mickey visits the clubhouse for a show-and-tell presentation.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x21
episodes_data.description: Minne and Daisy arrive at the clubhouse with Goldie the goldfish. However, Goldie is all alone and has no one to swim with so Daisy and Minnie decide take Goldie to the waterfall in the jungle to find a friend.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x22
episodes_data.description: Mickey, Minnie, Donald, Daisy, Goofy and Pluto blast off to outer space.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x23
episodes_data.description: A group of giant baby chicks is running loose in Mickey Park.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x24
episodes_data.description: Goofy has mysteriously disappeared and it's up to The Go-Getters to find him.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x25
episodes_data.description: Goofy babysits when Mickey and his pals are accidentally turned into toddlers by a time machine.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x26
episodes_data.description: Pluto becomes a brave prince in a fairy tale who tries to rescue princess Bella while watching out for Wizard Pete and his magic tricks.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x27
episodes_data.description: Goofy uses a special Thinking Cap to solve Clarabelle Cow's Scavenger Hunt!

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x28
episodes_data.description: Minnie and Daisy host a flower show for their friends.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x29
episodes_data.description: Prince Pete needs a nap but cannot fall asleep.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x30
episodes_data.description: The Gang gets on Professor von Drake's new submarine to retrieve Mickey's lucky coin.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x31
episodes_data.description: Donald cares for a lost egg, while his friends search for its family.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x32
episodes_data.description: Mickey and Daisy are dressed as detectives and, with the help of Minnie, Donald, Ludwig Von Drake, Goofy and Clarabelle, are on a mission to search for the golden statue of Boo Boo Chicken, before Pete gets to it first.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 3x33
episodes_data.description: Engineer Mickey is on a schedule to pick up his friends at the Choo-Choo train stations.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x1
episodes_data.description: Mickey and his pals plan to rescue the missing animals from the Clubhouse Farm.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x2
episodes_data.description: Pete snatches the Crystal Mickey statue from the clubhouse.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x3
episodes_data.description: A new invention makes Daisy's ponytail grow long.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x4
episodes_data.description: MIckey and pals hold a farm fun fair.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x5
episodes_data.description: Minnie and Pluto are swept up in a big wind and end up in the wonderful world of Dizz. And they need to get back to the clubhouse for the "Clubhouse Day" party.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x6
episodes_data.description: Super Mickey and the Clubhouse Heroes must work as a team.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x7
episodes_data.description: Kansas City Mickey returns to help the clubhouse team solve a mystery in the Hidden Jungle.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x8
episodes_data.description: It's time for Pluto's All-Star Pet Show at Minnie's Pet Salon.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x9
episodes_data.description: Minnie has a dream that she is Minnierella.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x10
episodes_data.description: Mickey and the gang are prepared to rock with a battle-of-the-bands showdown filled with epic guitar solos.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x11
episodes_data.description: Donald teaches a duckling a dance for a school talent day.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x12
episodes_data.description: Mickey and the gang search for something at the bottom of Mickey Lake. Mickey and the gang use a submarine to explore Mickey Lake, when Professor Von Drake's sonar-detecting machine discovers that there's something big at the bottom.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x13
episodes_data.description: Mickey and pals are enjoying a day at the beach when Peg Leg Pete delivers a note from Goofy’s long lost Grandpappy, Captain Goof-Beard, asking for the gang’s help in ensuring that Harmony-Chord Island, the musical isle where Goof-Beard lives, doesn’t go completely out of tune and sink.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x14
episodes_data.description: It's Mickey's birthday, and for his birthday present, the Clubhouse gang has organized fun activities for the big Mousekeday.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x15
episodes_data.description: While putting together the Winter Bow Show, Minnie and her nieces, Millie and Melody get swept away to the Clubhouse North Pole.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x16
episodes_data.description: Mickey, Minnie, and Pluto travel around the world to collect stamps for their special Clubhouse Passport.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x17
episodes_data.description: Professor Von Drake shows the Clubhouse pals a high-tech new game, Floatin' Fun-Time Mousekeball! But when the ball escapes, the game takes to the skies!

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x18
episodes_data.description: Mickey has birthday and his friends help him at the ceremony.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x19
episodes_data.description: Mousekedoer malfunctions and needs to be fixed.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x20
episodes_data.description: Mickey, Minnie and Pluto stumble upon Count Mikula's castle and help solve the mystery of its creaky noises.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x21
episodes_data.description: When Minnie is invited to sing at Mistletoe Mountain, Mickey discovers that all the instruments are missing.

episodes_data.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse 4x22
episodes_data.description: Mickey helps Goofy serve up deliveries from his "Chef Goofy On the Go" lunch truck.
